dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Have you encountered some troubles with your studies? Don't be afraid to tell Madam Faruzan. I'll give you all the help you need.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Of course, if you are in need of some life advice, feel free to consult with me as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I'm quite comfortable. Don't worry, I'm not one of those crabby old geezers who love to find fault with everything... I'm usually quite easy to please...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Don't you believe me?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Maybe I do nitpick every once in a while... but only with disrespectful students. Or those nonsensical rules at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: You're very agreeable, and the scenery here is quite lovely, so why wouldn't I like it here?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Haha, one does not run into youngsters as kind and considerate as yourself nowadays.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Let's say, hypothetically, I were to discover some design flaws after staying here for some time... you wouldn't mind if I shared them with you, would you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure! No problem.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Good, good. It seems like I'll be able to research my interests here to my heart's content after all.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Even if it ends up taking me another hundred years... Hehe, I will be quite content here.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmm... Could you get me some pens and paper?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: When I arrived in this realm for the first time, I was very surprised indeed by the unique configuration.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Just what kind of mechanism allows all of this to be ensconced in a single teapot... I need to do some research...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: But it wouldn't be polite to leave you with piles of notes everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Speaking of "chatting"... I once contemplated this concept in quite some depth.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: So here's a question for you: What sets conversation apart from other means of information exchange — such as a debate, or passing on a message?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The goal of "chatting" is to get to know somebody?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, that's exactly right.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: We want to learn more about the other person's feelings, opinions, and preferences. Plus, conversing also allows us to share interesting experiences, as well as ease each other's burdens.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: The exact topic of the conversation doesn't matter as long as you're learning about the other person.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Or to put it another way, every topic matters. For those who care about you, even the most trivial things about your life will be worth their full attention.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Alas. I regret to say in the past, I have never had the time to consider the value of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Day after day, I shut myself in and toiled away at my research... Even when I was out traveling in foreign lands, I made sure to keep my letters to friends and family short and to the point. I never shared any bad news, only the good.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I dare say that I earned the title of a scholar. Yet I cannot call myself a good daughter, student, or friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't say that, Madam Faruzan...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Whew... But there's no need to fret. You know me, I'm not one to dwell endlessly on the past...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I say all this only as a reminder to myself:

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: It's important to appreciate what you have in the here and now... to value and cherish the people you are close to.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Alright, there's no need to flatter me. If you agree with my sentiments, why don't you help me put them into practice?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: As someone I greatly value, you may occasionally find yourself in receipt of a letter from me, or indeed I may approach directly for a face-to-face conversation.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: ...I just hope you won't find me to be excessively chatty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm trying to figure out what the kids from the desert might enjoy. Would they prefer snacks or toys...?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Do you have some time to help me out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're headed to the desert?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. A colleague of mine left the Akademiya some time ago to return to the desert as a teacher. I received a missive from her the other day.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: She was wondering if I had any interest in paying her a visit, and perhaps holding a few literacy classes for the students...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's great! You'll finally have some new students!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Haha, so you haven't forgotten about my wish.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: But the point of this trip would be to just help them learn to read some of the most commonly used words.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: We want to make reading easier for them so they can hopefully discover more interests on their own.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: If some of the seeds that we plant today can take root and grow into lofty trees in the future, that is enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Whether they choose to pursue the same field of research as me is a separate matter... Ultimately, it will all depend on their natural aptitude.

choices.text: You're hoping that some of them do, right?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, look at you, trying to figure me out. Do I detect someone is getting a little too big for their boots?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: There's no point in teaching you a different kind of lesson right this moment, though. I still need time to finish some prep...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Speaking of prep... Ah, drat.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's wrong?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: It just came back to me. A little while ago, the Akademiya announced a new set of rules for off-site teaching. Every instructor must fill out a whole set of application forms.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Ugh, what a nuisance.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Oh well, to the ends of the ruins with that. When they find me out, I'll just say my memory failed me. It's not like they can do anything to me.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Planning for my visit to the desert is far more important. Why don't you come with me to pick out some gifts? Snacks and toys... Let's get a good selection of both.

choices.text: Surely you'll get at least ONE new student from this?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, look at you, trying to take a dig at me. Do I detect someone is getting a little too big for their boots?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Madam Faruzan!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Ah, and suddenly the whole day seems a bit brighter...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Madam Faruzan.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh? Can't keep your eyes open anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: That means you've worked hard today. Anything you didn't complete can be finished up tomorrow. Get some good rest!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh! So many books... including some antiques that I've never laid eyes on before! Wow, just skimming through a few pages, I'm already captivated...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Here, give me your hand. You've earned some candies. As for any questions you may have for me, or anything you want to bring to my attention... hold them for later.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Just let me peruse these treasures for a little while...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Do you think I could open a stall here? I can offer a few different services... translating ancient texts, deciphering puzzles, selling miniature mechanism models...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sounds like a perfect retirement plan... Hmph, forget it then!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: My body and mind are still in prime condition! Retirement? Maybe in another hundred years!
